output.tldr: Strong FY27 earnings resurgence masks 5-year negative cumulative free cash flow (-₹114 Cr), rapidly expanding borrowings (+6.2x), project execution delays (Polycarbonate, MIBK), and multi-year margin compression before recent recovery.

promises.promise: Q1 FY27 performance expected to be better sequentially than Q4 FY26.
promises.actual: Q1 FY27 revenue reached ₹2,578 Cr (vs ₹2,120 Cr in Q4 FY26) with PAT of ₹345 Cr.
promises.why: Q1 FY27 revenue and profit significantly exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.

promises.promise: Commissioning MIBK/MIBC project targeted within Q3 FY26.
promises.actual: Project commissioning target shifted to Q2 FY27 after prior two-year delays.
promises.why: Target pushed out from Q3 FY26 to Q2 FY27.

promises.promise: Polycarbonate project target commissioning by June 2028 / H2 FY29.
promises.actual: Integrated asset timeline pushed to FY30, aligned with feedstock plan.
promises.why: Integrated polycarbonate commissioning date moved back from FY29 to FY30.

promises.promise: Targeting total FY27 capex spend of around ₹2,500 crore.
promises.actual: By Q1 FY27 management lowered remaining FY27 spend expectation to ₹1,000-1,500 crore.
promises.why: FY27 capex guidance reduced from ₹2,500 crore to ₹1,000-1,500 crore.

promises.promise: Group expects a favourable overall performance in Q4 FY26.
promises.actual: Q4 FY26 op profit grew 18.6% YoY to ₹376 Cr and PAT grew 8.9% YoY.
promises.why: Q4 FY26 showed operating profit and PAT growth.

promises.promise: Advanced Intermediates FY27 EBIT targeted around ₹240 crore, rising to ₹400-420 crore in FY28.
promises.why: Target applies to future fiscal year FY28.

credibility.line: Management delivers strong cyclical operating turnarounds but consistently pushes back commissioning timelines and alters capex schedules.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Sustained R&D investments build high-margin proprietary chemistry product portfolio.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: 5-year annual OPM compressed from 24% in FY22 to 13% in FY26.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Expects stronger performance and margin expansion in Q1 FY27 over Q4 FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Q1 FY27 revenue grew to ₹2,578 Cr and OPM expanded to 21%.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Planned peak debt of ₹8,000-8,500 Cr with comfortable debt-to-equity under 1.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Borrowings grew 6.2x to ₹1,762 Cr while 5-year cumulative FCF is -₹114 Cr.

bull.point: Surging near-term revenue and profitability growth in FY27.
bull.evidence: Q2 FY27 revenue up 61.7% YoY to ₹3,076 Cr; PAT up 234.5%.

bull.point: Significant operating margin recovery driven by Phenolics segment.
bull.evidence: OPM reached 21% in Q1 FY27 and 20% in Q2 FY27.

bull.point: Healthy interest coverage and moderate current balance sheet leverage.
bull.evidence: Interest cover stands at 16.4x with debt-to-equity ratio at 0.27.

bear.point: Negative long-term free cash flow generation despite growth.
bear.evidence: Cumulative 5-year FCF is -₹114 Cr with CFO to PAT at 0.88.

bear.point: Rapid debt expansion to support massive upcoming capex program.
bear.evidence: Borrowings surged 6.2x in 3 years from ₹286 Cr to ₹1,762 Cr.

bear.point: Execution delays and timeline pushbacks on key growth projects.
bear.evidence: Polycarbonate integrated asset delayed to FY30; MIBK project delayed 2 years.

watch_next: Commissioning and earnings contribution of MIBK/MIBC and agrochemical projects in H2 FY27.
Phenolics spreads and margin sustainability amid prospective domestic market entry.
